newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **[Biotech]** **New mechanistic insights for BCKDK inhibitors** [BioStocks](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.06.757051)
  - Preclinical data demonstrate that BCKDK inhibitors directly antagonize the angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) and induce vasodilation independently of BCAA catabolism or BCKDK itself, revealing a major off-target pharmacological effect.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Biotech]** **AnaptysBio reports positive Phase 2 gluten-challenge data for ANB033 in celiac disease** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109601437588078846)
  - The study met its endpoints, showing a least-squares mean change in villus height to crypt depth (Vh:Cd) ratio of -0.17 on ANB033 versus -0.66 on placebo (a +0.49 placebo-adjusted delta, p = 0.009).
  - Intraepithelial lymphocyte (IEL) density changed by -1.20 on ANB033 versus +18.83 on placebo (a -20.03 placebo-adjusted delta, p < 0.001).

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Bristol Myers Squibb hits primary endpoint in Phase 3 ALOFT-IPF trial of admilparant** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109597861432209847)
  - Admilparant met its primary endpoint in adults with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, marking a major milestone for an LPA1 receptor antagonism campaign spanning over two decades.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **DEA issues new Notices of Intent on 7-OH products under HHS recommendations** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/public-health-focus/hiding-plain-sight-7-oh-products)
  - The updated framework establishes a Schedule I control threshold for 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) and mitragynine pseudoindoxyl (MGPI) when amounts exceed 1 mg/g in solids or 1 mg/mL in liquids, or when the mitragynine-to-derivative ratio is below 100:1, distinguishing concentrated products from botanical kratom.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Bausch + Lomb departs from CEO Brent Saunders** [BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2109598676142178638)
  - Thomas J. Appio was appointed interim CEO with immediate effect following a mutual agreement by Saunders and the Board of Directors to part ways.
- **Generic competition challenges Novartis in radioligand therapy** [BioStocks](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2109662313657643405)
  - Curium has priced its generic challenger at a 5% discount against **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis**' Lutathera, marking the third competitive challenge in the space alongside **[Big Pharma]** **Bristol Myers Squibb** and **[Biotech]** **Lantheus**.
- **Upcoming patent cliffs project over $500 billion in at-risk sales between 2026 and 2032** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/pharma-patent-cliff-merck-abbvie-dealmaking/832700/)
  - Norstella/Evaluate forecasting data reveals that patent expirations will arrive in waves rather than a single cliff, heavily impacting Merck & Co. near the 2028 Keytruda expiry, followed by AbbVie's Rinvoq and Skyrizi early next decade, driving aggressive dealmaking to refill pipelines.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **Analysis flags federal administrative actions on public health and vaccine infrastructure** [Science-Based Medicine](https://sciencebasedmedicine.org/rfk-jr-is-definitely-coming-for-your-vaccines-part-12-the-new-nih-vaccine-injury-clinic-is-likely-a-sham/)
  - Commentary evaluates the recent launch of an NIH vaccine injury clinic and ongoing structural changes under HHS leadership as part of broader shifts in federal vaccine policy.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [‘Omega-3 Fats promote Cancer’ - I’ve been Challenged!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YqWycbDff8Q) -- Physionic
        - Analyzes scientific literature examining claims that omega-3 fatty acid intake or plasma levels promote cancer, specifically prostate cancer.
        - Reviews epidemiological evidence from multiple studies (such as Brasky et al. and Aronson et al.) investigating associations between polyunsaturated fatty acids and oncogenesis.
        - Evaluates counter-arguments and methodology across cited studies to determine whether observed correlations represent true biological risk or confounding factors.
    - [Strong convictions, loosely held: how Peter’s views on fasting, keto, exercise, & more have changed](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6DR8E5QJoCY) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Revisits nutritional strategies, stepping back from ketogenic diets and prolonged fasting due to muscle mass loss concerns, while noting GLP-1 agonists favor calorie restriction.
        - Details the rationale for stopping off-label metformin use in metabolically healthy individuals and expresses uncertainty regarding human translation and dosing of rapamycin.
        - Assesses diagnostic imaging and screening, noting quality drop-offs in whole-body MRIs and questioning liquid biopsy utility (e.g., NHS-Galleri trial) for early-stage cancer detection.
        - Re-evaluates exercise programming, adapting Zone 2 cardio paradigms for low-volume schedules and eliminating heavy barbell squats and deadlifts to minimize injury risk.
    - [Your Next Care Team Member May Not Be Human](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/H80gE2T8N5U) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Explores the role of specialized AI agents working alongside healthcare providers as non-human care team members.
        - Outlines how AI systems utilize electronic medical records to assist physicians with clinical workflows and direct patient support.
        - Describes the potential for AI technology to scale healthcare outreach and monitoring to tens of millions of patients.
    - [AI Founders: Are You Sure You Have a Moat?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qGJd3CBmS9c) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Examines the defensibility and long-term moats of healthcare AI startups in a competitive market.
        - Highlights why traditional milestones—such as developing a stand-alone app, acquiring initial customers, or integrating with Epic Systems—do not guarantee protection against competitors.
        - Explains that large tech platforms leverage superior scale, technology, distribution networks, and data access to potentially displace smaller AI health applications.
- Pure Science
    - [12 - Toss  #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oMS6Pd02b_g) -- El Jj
        - Presents a variant of the "heads I win, tails you lose" coin-toss concept tailored for mathematical problem-solving.
        - Illustrates how subtle modifications to coin-flipping rules or game structures create favorable probability imbalances.
        - Formulates a short mathematical entry focused on game variants as part of the #mathctober series.
